description: Generate immersive multi-speaker dialogue audio (MP3) from text + voice_id pairs with ElevenLabs eleven_v3.
summary: Multi-speaker text-to-dialogue: pass ordered {text, voice_id} pairs (voices from /voices, up to 10 unique) and get one continuous MP3 with distinct speakers, emotional audio tags ([giggling], [whispering]) supported. Output is base64 (audio_base64) with the billed character_count. Priced per character ($0.08/1k, eleven_v3).

text.description: The line to speak. Supports eleven_v3 audio tags like [giggling], [curious], [whispering].

voice_id.description: The ElevenLabs voice for this line — pick voice_ids from /voices (max 10 unique voices per request).

inputs.description: The dialogue: ordered text + voice_id pairs, rendered as one continuous audio file.

language_code.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code to enforce.

settings.description: Optional generation settings, passed through verbatim.

stability.description: Voice stability (0–1). Lower = broader emotional range.

body.description: Convert a multi-speaker dialogue to speech audio

notes: Generated audio is saved on Monid cloud with a default 7-day retention; the run output carries an `audio` object with a fresh signed download_link (valid ~1h — re-fetch the run for a new one), content_type and link/file expiries. To keep the file past retention, download it via the link and re-upload with the sfs /put endpoint; after retention the object reads { expired: true }. audio_base64 appears inline only if the save failed.
Total text across all inputs is capped at 2000 characters per run — split longer dialogues into multiple runs.
Output is MP3 44.1kHz 128kbps, returned base64-encoded in the run output (audio_base64).
Billed on the summed character count of all inputs[].text.

hints.list available voices: curl -X POST http://api.monid.ai/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"elevenlabs","endpoint":"/voices","input":{"body":<BODY>,"queryParams":<QUERY_PARAMS>,"pathParams":<PATH_PARAMS>}}'  # the free voice catalog — use voice_ids from it here
hints.single-voice speech: curl -X POST http://api.monid.ai/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"elevenlabs","endpoint":"/text-to-speech","input":{"body":<BODY>,"queryParams":<QUERY_PARAMS>,"pathParams":<PATH_PARAMS>}}'  # one voice, half the price with eleven_flash_v2_5
